safetyScore.title: Creator Safety Score Detail
safetyScore.weightsNotice: Configurable scoring weights: Comments (35%), Threats/PII (30%), Image Comparison (20%), Recency (15%). Max 100.
safetyScore.disclaimer: This is an internal indicator based solely on activity recorded in ABHEDYA, not an objective measurement of your actual safety. Missing data does not imply danger, and a low score does not guarantee absolute safety.
safetyScore.noData: No incidents or safety signals recorded yet. Your current indicator is at baseline.

watermark.title: Photo Watermarking Workspace
watermark.subtitle: Client-side image protection, ownership verification, and cryptographic fingerprinting
watermark.uploadPrompt: Drop your image here, or browse files
watermark.uploadHelp: Supports JPG, JPEG, PNG, WebP up to 10 MB. Processed entirely in your browser.
watermark.regionDisclaimer: Protection regions are manual positioning guides to assist placement; ABHEDYA does not perform automated body-part classification.
watermark.payloadHelp: Lightweight reversible spatial LSB encoder. Note: heavy compression, format conversion, or resizing can degrade invisible payloads.
watermark.savedSuccess: Protection record saved to Evidence Vault successfully.
watermark.limitationNotice: Important Limitation: Watermarks provide proof of ownership and deter misuse, but cannot mathematically guarantee prevention of unauthorized cropping or recompression.

comparison.title: Photo Comparison & Tamper Analysis
comparison.subtitle: Forensic pixel-difference calculation, SSIM metric, and difference region localization
comparison.uploadHelp: JPG, PNG, WebP up to 10 MB

steps.visualizing: Generating heatmap and threshold contour masks...

interpretation.identical: Exact Cryptographic Match: The two files have identical SHA-256 fingerprints (0.00% difference).
interpretation.pixelIdentical: Pixel Identical: Images share identical pixel values across all color channels.
interpretation.differencesFound: Regions differing from the supplied original have been localized.
interpretation.honestDisclaimer: Metric Disclaimer: These measured differences show where the suspected image deviates from the reference. Pixel differences alone do not prove malicious intent, AI generation, or criminal tampering; compression artifacts, lighting, and crops also influence metrics.

comparison.savedSuccess: Forensic comparison record saved to Evidence Vault.

risks.high: High Risk / Multiple Red Flags Detected
risks.critical: Critical Alert / Coercive or Inappropriate Demands

actions.pause: Pause before responding. Do not rush into commitments.
actions.verify: Independently verify the production house, casting director, and official registered address.
actions.consult: Discuss the opportunity with a trusted mentor, union representative, or family member.
actions.noFees: Never transfer upfront registration, audition, or portfolio fees.
actions.noPrivateContent: Refuse requests for private, unclothed, or compromising photos/videos.
actions.publicVenue: Insist on verified, professional daylight casting venues with an accompanying companion.
actions.preserve: Preserve message timestamps and contact identifiers in Evidence Vault.

pdf.safetyScoreSection: Creator Safety Score Indicator at Incident Time
pdf.disclaimerText: This report compiles user-submitted statements and verifiable client-side cryptographic hashes and algorithmic measurements recorded in ABHEDYA. It is designed to assist law enforcement, legal counsel, and platform safety teams in reviewing incidents. ABHEDYA does not independently verify physical identities or provide formal judicial certification.
